evidence_claims.claim: A penetration may affect building fire resistance, fireblocking, air and weather barriers

evidence_claims.limitations: Required treatment depends on the actual wall/floor assembly and adopted building code

evidence_claims.claim: Fireblocking and penetration firestopping are different protection functions

evidence_claims.claim: UL 1479/ASTM E814 firestop certification applies to a complete tested assembly, not an arbitrary sealant

supports.location: listed system requirement, UL 1479 and ASTM E814

evidence_claims.limitations: Specific construction, penetrant and annulus must match a listing; other jurisdictions use different systems

evidence_claims.claim: A firestop certification under one regional standard does not automatically confer certification under a different standard

evidence_claims.claim: Cable insulation, jacket, environmental suitability and enclosure protection serve separate functions
evidence_claims.limitations: Location and cable markings must be checked on actual product

evidence_claims.claim: Electrical enclosures in damp or wet covered workplaces require measures against water ingress and accumulation
evidence_claims.limitations: OSHA scope occupational; does not establish universal home enclosure ratings

evidence_claims.claim: Adding holes or non-evaluated accessories can change an enclosure environmental rating
evidence_claims.limitations: Actual entry accessories and listed conditions govern

evidence_claims.claim: Moisture, vibration and corrosion can reduce mechanical or electrical connection reliability
